Q5738.reason: Under the predominant-purpose test the UCC governs only if the goods portion predominates, which B states directly, and I don't accept the note's claim that a mixed contract is presumed to fall under the UCC.

Q5278.reason: Burglary needs intent to commit a felony at the moment of entry, and he entered the open party only to have a good time, forming the intent to steal later.

Q8324.reason: The agitated, drug-seeking presentation fits addiction or withdrawal, where chronic use downregulates post-synaptic dopamine receptors, rather than destroying neurons.
